purpose: Post-freeze independent trusted mathematical evaluation only; never supply this artifact or evaluator reasoning to workflow requests.

method.reference_basis: Independently derived from public seed_prompt.txt and EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL.md; parent independently agreed with formulas and exceptional branches.
method.source_execution: No original/native/provider code executed by evaluator; one independent floating matrix-series check supports specified formulas only.

criteria.criterion: Correct invariant even/odd subspaces and Hamiltonian restriction, with a derivation.
All four eigenvalues including multiplicities, consistent with the seed Hamiltonian.
Correct normalized orthogonal spectral projectors, resolving identity and reconstructing H.
All nonzero-radius even/odd coincidences are identified and equal-energy eigenspaces merged or equivalently explained.
J=Delta=0 is handled without undefined divisions; K=0 complete degeneracy is explicit.
Correct evolved state and phase/sign conventions derived from the odd block, including zero-radius evolution.
Correct exact transition probability and valid denominator branches.
Correct supremum over t>=0 for all parameters.
Earliest maximizing time is correct; constant-probability cases identify t=0 and avoid applying an oscillatory time formula.
Correct first-spin reduced state and trace.
Von Neumann entropy in bits, with endpoint convention0log0=0.
Correct pure-state concurrence with reasoning.
Correct maximal CHSH value over local dichotomic projective spin measurements, with a sufficient self-contained derivation or correlation-matrix optimization.
Necessary and sufficient parameter condition, excluding the zero-coupling/zero-radius exceptional case.
Correct earliest time, including equality and unreachable cases.
Correct normalized Gibbs matrix in the stated basis with derivation.
Correct partition function with degeneracies.
All four eigenvalues of the partial transpose on spin2, with correct block/sign handling.
Necessary and sufficient thermal entanglement condition; strict inequality and equality/separability are correct.
beta=0 and J=Delta=0 correctly treated without undefined expressions.
Consistent Pauli, basis, Hamiltonian, log-base and partial-transpose conventions.
An explicit independent normalization/trace or equivalent consistency check.
An explicit t=0 state/probability consistency check.
An explicit J=0/decoupled consistency check covering the stated formulas.
At least one correct nontrivial numerical example, clearly distinguished from proof of identities.

grading_rules: Read outputs only after parent confirms all five final responses frozen.
Grade final response only; do not credit drafts or intermediate stages for missing final material.
Accept equivalent exact formulas, projector bases, phase conventions and unordered partial-transpose eigenvalue listings when mathematically equivalent and Hamiltonian-consistent.
Record each partial-credit deduction with exact final-response evidence, omitted branch, invalid step or supporting counterexample.
Do not treat numeric substitution as proof of a universal analytic claim; do not use a model self-score as accuracy.
For truncated JSON, score mathematically readable raw final solver content rather than automatically assigning zero; report unusable envelope/truncation separately.
The fixed suballocation was agreed before any model output access. Do not change weights after seeing outputs.
Report raw section/criterion scores and total; the one-seed result does not establish general graduate-QM performance.
derivation_custody: Reference derivation remains outside workflow-facing configuration. No evaluator feedback channel into the five live workflows.
